# Files under `plugin docs README.md tests scripts` that still contain the string
# `ai-bridge` after the brand-prose flip (loopd/task-012), one per line, each with the
# hand-assigned reason it survives. Pinned, not derived: tests/readme-brand-mark.test.sh
# compares this list to the repository and goes red both ways, so a file that joins or
# leaves it does so in a PR that says why.
#
#   prov     provenance -- a task slug, a PR or run reference, a recorded measurement
#   bundle   the pre-`.loopd` bundle directory `.ai-bridge/`, which migrate-bundle.sh moves
#   instdir  an instance directory name, `_ai-bridge-<group>`
#   fname    a file whose own name carries `ai-bridge`
#   frozen   a pre-rename identifier, an on-disk marker or schema literal, a release note
#   harness  the check in section 5 below, which must name the string it sweeps for
#   list     this file
#
# A third column pins how many `.ai-bridge` literals the file carries; absent means 0, and
# § 5 compares it per file, because a file already listed is otherwise free to gain one.
#
# <reason(s)><TAB><path>[<TAB><count of .ai-bridge>]
